page.overview:
Who is Caccino the Wise?

Caccino the Wise was a priest of great renown in the Cult of Verena who is now a divine servant of the goddess of knowledge who can be summoned by her priests.

His connection to the goddess Verena is so deep that his spirit can be summoned with the Divine Magic ritual available to clerics of Verena known as Call Divine Servant.

In life, Caccino the Wise is believed to have built a temple in honor of his patron deity Verena deep below the folds of the Irrana Mountains in northern Tilea.

There still lies a corpse. According to the temple records, it has lain there for almost 900 years, unchanging and unspoilt by the ravages of time. The local priests of the Cult of Verena guard it carefully, for they believe it once housed the soul of the man who founded the temple. Once a year, the temple's high priest conducts a three-day ceremony that culminates in the "Sacred Scraping," during which the corpse is scraped from head to toe with a blessed blade. After several hours, the high priest will have gathered about a jar's worth of "Holy Grease," known as the Grease of Caccino, a yellowish substance with the texture of jelly.
